info.title: Smart Farm API
info.description: Multi-farm livestock health and farm management API. Every farm-scoped request must send the X-Farm-ID header with a farm the user belongs to.

get.description:
Resolves request.farm / request.membership before permission checks run.

The active farm is also put into the request context, so FarmScopedModel managers
scope every query in this request, including ones inside serializers and services.

parameters.name: X-Farm-ID
parameters.description: ID of the active farm. Must be a farm the user belongs to.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
* `create` - Created
* `update` - Updated
* `delete` - Deleted
* `restore` - Restored
* `status_change` - Status changed
